task: Look up the definition, pronunciation, and examples of the word "zeitgeist."
answer: Definition of 'zeitgeist': the general set of ideas, beliefs, feelings, etc. that is typical of a particular period in history. Pronunciation: UK /ˈtsaɪt.ɡaɪst/, US /ˈzaɪt.ɡaɪst/ (with audio available). Example: 'Put in the contemporary context, this change also mirrored the overall rebellious zeitgeist of civil society...'
